<!-- Author: Kunru Song -->

This report characterizes the accepted S5.3 networks using the prespecified,
network-specific measures. Temporal centrality is signed expected influence
only; contemporaneous and between-person centrality is absolute strength only.
Autoregressive self-loops and temporal predictability are reported separately.
Signed, target-specific bridge expected influence for all three networks is
reported in S6.2; undirected cross-community absolute-weight summaries are not
part of this report.

Set `use_saved_results = TRUE` when rendering an existing analysis report from
its saved aggregate results and SVG figures. This mode performs no analysis or
result export; the default mode runs the reproducible calculation and export
code shown below.

# Load accepted upstream objects

```{r load-upstream, eval=!use_saved_results}
dat_step5_mlvar <- load_single_object(data_file, "dat_step5_mlvar")
fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar <- load_single_object(fit_file, "fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar")
results_s5_3_mlvar_networks <- load_single_object(
  network_file, "results_s5_3_mlvar_networks"
)

node_map <- dat_step5_mlvar$node_map
node_names <- node_map$node
full_matrices <- results_s5_3_mlvar_networks$full_matrices[c(
  "temporal", "contemporaneous", "between"
)]
sparse_matrices <- results_s5_3_mlvar_networks$sparse_matrices
edge_tables <- results_s5_3_mlvar_networks$edge_tables

stopifnot(
  nrow(node_map) == 12L,
  identical(node_map$node, node_names),
  identical(sort(unique(node_map$community)), sort(c(
    "Engagement Time", "PSMU", "Distress"
  ))),
  sum(node_map$subgroup == "Core", na.rm = TRUE) == 4L,
  sum(node_map$subgroup == "Peripheral", na.rm = TRUE) == 2L,
  all(vapply(c(full_matrices, sparse_matrices), function(x) {
    identical(dim(x), c(12L, 12L)) &&
      identical(rownames(x), node_names) && identical(colnames(x), node_names) &&
      all(is.finite(x))
  }, logical(1)))
)
```

# Centrality calculations

All self-loops are set to zero before centrality calculation. The full matrices
are canonical; the raw-p sparse matrices are a prespecified display-threshold
sensitivity and are never used to choose a preferred ranking. Because this
threshold uses unadjusted `p < .05`, the sparse version is exploratory.

```{r centrality-functions, eval=!use_saved_results}
node_metadata <- node_map |>
  dplyr::select(node, label, short_label, community, subgroup)

temporal_centrality <- function(matrix, version) {
  matrix <- matrix[node_names, node_names, drop = FALSE]
  diag(matrix) <- 0
  community <- stats::setNames(node_map$community, node_map$node)

  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(node_names, function(node) {
    other_community <- community != community[[node]]
    data.frame(
      version = version,
      network = "Temporal",
      node = node,
      metric = c(
        "Outgoing expected influence", "Incoming expected influence",
        "Bridge outgoing expected influence", "Bridge incoming expected influence"
      ),
      value = c(
        sum(matrix[node, ]),
        sum(matrix[, node]),
        sum(matrix[node, other_community]),
        sum(matrix[other_community, node])
      ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })) |>
    dplyr::left_join(node_metadata, by = "node")
}

undirected_centrality <- function(matrix, version, network) {
  matrix <- matrix[node_names, node_names, drop = FALSE]
  diag(matrix) <- 0
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(node_names, function(node) {
    data.frame(
      version = version,
      network = network,
      node = node,
      metric = "Strength",
      value = sum(abs(matrix[node, ])),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })) |>
    dplyr::left_join(node_metadata, by = "node")
}

centrality <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  temporal_centrality(full_matrices$temporal, "Full"),
  undirected_centrality(
    full_matrices$contemporaneous, "Full", "Contemporaneous"
  ),
  undirected_centrality(full_matrices$between, "Full", "Between-person"),
  temporal_centrality(sparse_matrices$temporal, "Raw-p sparse"),
  undirected_centrality(
    sparse_matrices$contemporaneous, "Raw-p sparse", "Contemporaneous"
  ),
  undirected_centrality(
    sparse_matrices$between, "Raw-p sparse", "Between-person"
  )
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    network_metric = paste(network, metric, sep = ": "),
    node = factor(node, levels = rev(node_names))
  )

locked_metric_audit <- centrality |>
  dplyr::distinct(network, metric) |>
  dplyr::arrange(network, metric)

stopifnot(
  nrow(centrality) == (12L * 4L + 12L + 12L) * 2L,
  !any(grepl("strength", centrality$metric[
    centrality$network == "Temporal"
  ], ignore.case = TRUE)),
  !any(grepl("expected influence", centrality$metric[
    centrality$network != "Temporal"
  ], ignore.case = TRUE)),
  !any(grepl("closeness|betweenness", centrality$metric, ignore.case = TRUE)),
  all(is.finite(centrality$value))
)

```

```{r metric-table}
knitr::kable(locked_metric_audit, format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Inertia and temporal predictability

```{r inertia-predictability, eval=!use_saved_results}
autoregressive_inertia <- data.frame(
  node = node_names,
  estimate_full = diag(full_matrices$temporal),
  estimate_sparse = diag(sparse_matrices$temporal),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(node_metadata, by = "node") |>
  dplyr::mutate(supported_p05 = estimate_sparse != 0)

model_data <- fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$data
model_residuals <- fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$step1_residuals
stopifnot(
  nrow(model_data) == nrow(model_residuals),
  all(node_names %in% names(model_data)),
  all(node_names %in% names(model_residuals)),
  "Name_ID" %in% names(model_data)
)

temporal_predictability <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(node_names, function(node) {
  outcome <- model_data[[node]]
  residual <- model_residuals[[node]]
  person_mean <- ave(outcome, model_data$Name_ID, FUN = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  centered_outcome <- outcome - person_mean
  denominator <- sum(centered_outcome^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  residual_ss <- sum(residual^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    node = node,
    observations = sum(stats::complete.cases(centered_outcome, residual)),
    within_total_ss = denominator,
    conditional_residual_ss = residual_ss,
    temporal_predictability_r2 = 1 - residual_ss / denominator,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})) |>
  dplyr::left_join(node_metadata, by = "node")

stopifnot(
  nrow(temporal_predictability) == 12L,
  all(temporal_predictability$observations == nrow(model_data)),
  all(is.finite(temporal_predictability$temporal_predictability_r2)),
  all(temporal_predictability$temporal_predictability_r2 <= 1)
)

```

```{r inertia-table}
knitr::kable(round_numeric_columns(autoregressive_inertia), format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r predictability-table}
knitr::kable(round_numeric_columns(temporal_predictability), format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Network characteristics and edge categories

```{r network-characteristics, eval=!use_saved_results}
network_characteristics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  edge_tables$temporal |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      network = "Temporal cross-lag",
      included = !self_loop,
      supported = supported_p05
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(included) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      network = dplyr::first(network), possible_edges = dplyr::n(),
      supported_edges = sum(supported), density_sparse = mean(supported),
      positive_supported = sum(supported & estimate > 0),
      negative_supported = sum(supported & estimate < 0),
      mean_signed_full = mean(estimate), mean_absolute_full = mean(abs(estimate)),
      maximum_absolute_full = max(abs(estimate))
    ),
  edge_tables$contemporaneous |>
    dplyr::mutate(network = "Contemporaneous", supported = supported_p05) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      network = dplyr::first(network), possible_edges = dplyr::n(),
      supported_edges = sum(supported), density_sparse = mean(supported),
      positive_supported = sum(supported & estimate > 0),
      negative_supported = sum(supported & estimate < 0),
      mean_signed_full = mean(estimate), mean_absolute_full = mean(abs(estimate)),
      maximum_absolute_full = max(abs(estimate))
    ),
  edge_tables$between |>
    dplyr::mutate(network = "Between-person", supported = supported_p05) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      network = dplyr::first(network), possible_edges = dplyr::n(),
      supported_edges = sum(supported), density_sparse = mean(supported),
      positive_supported = sum(supported & estimate > 0),
      negative_supported = sum(supported & estimate < 0),
      mean_signed_full = mean(estimate), mean_absolute_full = mean(abs(estimate)),
      maximum_absolute_full = max(abs(estimate))
    )
)

temporal_edge_categories <- edge_tables$temporal |>
  dplyr::filter(!self_loop) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    network = "Temporal", relation = paste(from_community, "->", to_community),
    estimate, supported = supported_p05
  )
undirected_categories <- function(edges, network) {
  edges |>
    dplyr::rowwise() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      relation = paste(sort(c(node1_community, node2_community)), collapse = " -- ")
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::transmute(network = network, relation, estimate, supported = supported_p05)
}
edge_category_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  temporal_edge_categories,
  undirected_categories(edge_tables$contemporaneous, "Contemporaneous"),
  undirected_categories(edge_tables$between, "Between-person")
) |>
  dplyr::group_by(network, relation) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    possible_edges = dplyr::n(), supported_edges = sum(supported),
    mean_signed_full = mean(estimate), mean_absolute_full = mean(abs(estimate)),
    mean_signed_sparse = mean(ifelse(supported, estimate, 0)),
    mean_absolute_sparse = mean(ifelse(supported, abs(estimate), 0)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(
  sum(network_characteristics$possible_edges) == 132L + 66L + 66L,
  all(network_characteristics$supported_edges == c(
    sum(!edge_tables$temporal$self_loop & edge_tables$temporal$supported_p05),
    sum(edge_tables$contemporaneous$supported_p05),
    sum(edge_tables$between$supported_p05)
  ))
)
```

# Normalized Core-Peripheral summaries

Because Core contains four nodes and Peripheral contains two, every subgroup
summary below is a mean per node or mean per possible edge, never a raw sum.

```{r subgroup-summaries, eval=!use_saved_results}
subgroup_centrality <- centrality |>
  dplyr::filter(as.character(subgroup) %in% c("Core", "Peripheral")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(subgroup = as.character(subgroup)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(version, network, metric, subgroup) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    nodes = dplyr::n(), mean_per_node = mean(value), sd_across_nodes = stats::sd(value),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = subgroup,
    values_from = c(nodes, mean_per_node, sd_across_nodes)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    core_minus_peripheral_mean = mean_per_node_Core - mean_per_node_Peripheral
  )

make_temporal_bridge_profiles <- function(matrix, version) {
  psmu <- node_map |>
    dplyr::filter(community == "PSMU") |>
    dplyr::select(node, subgroup)
  targets <- c("Engagement Time", "Distress")
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(psmu)), function(index) {
    node <- psmu$node[[index]]
    dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(targets, function(target) {
      target_nodes <- node_map$node[node_map$community == target]
      data.frame(
        version = version, network = "Temporal", subgroup = psmu$subgroup[[index]],
        psmu_node = node, target_community = target,
        direction = c("PSMU -> target", "target -> PSMU"),
        normalized_bridge_value = c(
          mean(matrix[node, target_nodes]), mean(matrix[target_nodes, node])
        ),
        metric = "Signed mean per possible edge",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }))
  }))
}

bridge_profiles_node <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  make_temporal_bridge_profiles(full_matrices$temporal, "Full"),
  make_temporal_bridge_profiles(sparse_matrices$temporal, "Raw-p sparse")
)

bridge_profiles_subgroup <- bridge_profiles_node |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    version, network, subgroup, target_community, direction, metric
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    psmu_nodes = dplyr::n(),
    mean_per_node_and_possible_edge = mean(normalized_bridge_value),
    sd_across_psmu_nodes = stats::sd(normalized_bridge_value),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = subgroup,
    values_from = c(
      psmu_nodes, mean_per_node_and_possible_edge, sd_across_psmu_nodes
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    core_minus_peripheral = mean_per_node_and_possible_edge_Core -
      mean_per_node_and_possible_edge_Peripheral
  )

stopifnot(
  all(subgroup_centrality$nodes_Core == 4L),
  all(subgroup_centrality$nodes_Peripheral == 2L),
  all(bridge_profiles_subgroup$psmu_nodes_Core == 4L),
  all(bridge_profiles_subgroup$psmu_nodes_Peripheral == 2L),
  all(is.finite(bridge_profiles_subgroup$core_minus_peripheral))
)
```

# Figures

```{r figures, fig.width=14, fig.height=11, eval=!use_saved_results}
community_colors <- c(
  "Engagement Time" = "#D99A28", "PSMU" = "#7A4CC2", "Distress" = "#319B55"
)

make_centrality_plot <- function(version) {
  centrality |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$version == .env$version) |>
    ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = value, y = node, color = community)) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey75") +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      ggplot2::aes(x = 0, xend = value, yend = node), linewidth = 0.65, alpha = 0.75
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.6) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ network_metric, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = community_colors) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste(version, "network-specific centrality"),
      subtitle = paste(
        "Temporal: signed EI only; contemporaneous/between-person: strength only;",
        "self-loops excluded"
      ),
      x = "Centrality value", y = NULL, color = "Community"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(2, "lines"),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}

centrality_full_plot <- make_centrality_plot("Full")
centrality_sparse_plot <- make_centrality_plot("Raw-p sparse")

bridge_profiles_plot <- bridge_profiles_subgroup |>
  dplyr::filter(version == "Full") |>
  dplyr::select(
    network, target_community, direction,
    Core = mean_per_node_and_possible_edge_Core,
    Peripheral = mean_per_node_and_possible_edge_Peripheral
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(Core, Peripheral), names_to = "subgroup", values_to = "value") |>
  dplyr::mutate(panel = paste(network, direction, sep = ": ")) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = target_community, y = value, fill = subgroup)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.68) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free_y") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(Core = "#6A3D9A", Peripheral = "#B39DDB")) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Temporal Core-Peripheral bridge profiles from the full network",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Means per PSMU node and possible cross-community edge;",
      "signed temporal weights; undirected Bridge EI is reported in S6.2"
    ),
    x = "Target community", y = "Normalized bridge value", fill = "PSMU subgroup"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
  )

predictability_plot <- temporal_predictability |>
  dplyr::mutate(node = factor(node, levels = node_names)) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    ggplot2::aes(x = node, y = temporal_predictability_r2, fill = community)
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = community_colors) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Node-wise temporal predictability",
    subtitle = "Conditional sample R-squared; a non-centrality summary",
    x = NULL, y = expression(R^2), fill = "Community"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r export-results, include=FALSE, eval=!use_saved_results}
  ),
  Edge_Category_Summary = round_numeric_columns(edge_category_summary),
  Node_Map = node_map
)

bruceR::export(workbook_sheets, file = table_file, overwrite = TRUE)
style_and_sanitize_workbook(table_file, workbook_sheets)

sheet_names <- readxl::excel_sheets(table_file)
reloaded_sheets <- stats::setNames(
  lapply(sheet_names, function(sheet) {
    readxl::read_excel(table_file, sheet = sheet, .name_repair = "minimal")
  }),
  sheet_names
)
formula_errors <- sum(vapply(reloaded_sheets, function(data) {
  sum(
    grepl(
      "^#(REF|VALUE|DIV/0|NAME|N/A|NUM|NULL)",
      as.matrix(data), ignore.case = TRUE
    ),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}, numeric(1)))

figure_audit <- data.frame(
  figure = names(figure_files), file = basename(figure_files),
  bytes = as.numeric(file.info(figure_files)$size),
  md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(figure_files)), saved_by_ggsave = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
workbook_audit <- data.frame(
  file = "Res_3_Results/Table_S5_5_mlVARCharacteristics.xlsx",
  sheets = length(sheet_names),
  exact_sheet_names = identical(sheet_names, names(workbook_sheets)),
  formula_errors = formula_errors,
  bytes = as.numeric(file.info(table_file)$size),
  md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(table_file)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

results_s5_5_mlvar_characteristics <- list(
  network_characteristics = network_characteristics,
  edge_category_summary = edge_category_summary,
  centrality = centrality |> dplyr::mutate(node = as.character(node)),
  locked_metric_audit = locked_metric_audit,
  autoregressive_inertia = autoregressive_inertia,
  temporal_predictability = temporal_predictability,
  subgroup_centrality = subgroup_centrality,
  bridge_profiles_node = bridge_profiles_node,
  bridge_profiles_subgroup = bridge_profiles_subgroup,
  workbook_audit = workbook_audit,
  figure_audit = figure_audit,
  provenance = list(
    data_input = "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/dat_step5_mlvar.rda",
    data_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(data_file)),
    fit_input = "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar.rda",
    fit_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(fit_file)),
    network_input = "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/results_s5_3_mlvar_networks.rda",
    network_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(network_file)),
    generating_script = "Step_5_mlVAR_Network_Analysis/S5_5_CharacterizemlVARNetworks.Rmd",
    canonical_centrality = "Full unthresholded matrices",
    sparse_sensitivity = paste(
      "Unadjusted p < .05 sparse matrices; exploratory display-threshold",
      "sensitivity with no multiplicity correction"
    ),
    temporal_metrics = c(
      "Outgoing expected influence", "Incoming expected influence",
      "Bridge outgoing expected influence", "Bridge incoming expected influence"
    ),
    undirected_metrics = "Strength",
    excluded_from_this_report = c(
      "Temporal strength", "Closeness", "Betweenness"
    ),
    bridge_expected_influence_owner = "S6_2_NodeBridgeExpectedInfluence.R",
    normalization_rule = "Core and Peripheral comparisons use means per node/possible edge"
  )
)

save(results_s5_5_mlvar_characteristics, file = result_file, version = 2)
rm(results_s5_5_mlvar_characteristics)
results_s5_5_mlvar_characteristics <- load_single_object(
  result_file, "results_s5_5_mlvar_characteristics"
)

stopifnot(
  identical(sheet_names, names(workbook_sheets)),
  formula_errors == 0L,
  all(figure_audit$bytes > 1000),
  all(figure_audit$saved_by_ggsave),
  file.exists(result_file),
  nrow(results_s5_5_mlvar_characteristics$centrality) == nrow(centrality)
)

```

```{r validate-exports, include=FALSE, eval=!use_saved_results}
s5_5_acceptance <- data.frame(
  criterion = c(
    "Canonical statistics calculated from full unthresholded matrices",
    "Same locked statistics repeated on raw-p sparse matrices",
    "Temporal reports EI and bridge EI but no strength",
    "Contemporaneous/between report strength but no EI",
    "Self-loops excluded from centrality and retained as inertia",
    "Temporal predictability reported as a non-centrality summary",
    "Core-Peripheral summaries normalized for subgroup size",
    "Excel workbook reloads with exact sheets and no formula errors",
    "All canonical SVG figures written by ggsave",
    "Durable S5.5 RDA reloads"
  ),
  passed = c(
    all(c("Full", "Raw-p sparse") %in% centrality$version),
    all(c("Full", "Raw-p sparse") %in% centrality$version),
    !any(grepl("strength", centrality$metric[
      centrality$network == "Temporal"
    ], ignore.case = TRUE)),
    !any(grepl("expected influence", centrality$metric[
      centrality$network != "Temporal"
    ], ignore.case = TRUE)),
    nrow(autoregressive_inertia) == 12L &&
      all(!is.na(autoregressive_inertia$estimate_full)),
    nrow(temporal_predictability) == 12L,
    all(subgroup_centrality$nodes_Core == 4L) &&
      all(subgroup_centrality$nodes_Peripheral == 2L) &&
      all(bridge_profiles_subgroup$psmu_nodes_Core == 4L) &&
      all(bridge_profiles_subgroup$psmu_nodes_Peripheral == 2L),
    workbook_audit$exact_sheet_names && workbook_audit$formula_errors == 0L,
    all(file.exists(figure_files)) &&
      all(figure_audit$saved_by_ggsave),
    file.exists(result_file)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stopifnot(all(s5_5_acceptance$passed))
```
